runtime: class RuntimeStateService { RedisTemplate<String, Object> redisTemplate; EnumSet<RuntimeStateField> allowedFields; Duration ttl = Duration.ofMinutes(10); void update() { redisTemplate.expire("runtime", ttl); } void clearConversation(String conversationId) { redisTemplate.delete(conversationId); } }
conversation: class ConversationService { ConversationStore conversationStore; public void delete(String conversationId, String userId) { requireOwned(conversationId, userId); conversationStore.deleteOwned(conversationId, userId); } }
agent: class AgentExecutionService { public Map execute(Request request) { String continueTraceId = request.getContinueTraceId(); Map existingSnapshot = taskRegistry.get(continueTraceId); runtimeStateService.consumeTurnInput(scope); taskRegistry.save(continueTraceId, existingSnapshot); return existingSnapshot; } public Map confirmApproval(Request request) { Map snapshot = taskRegistry.findByApprovalToken(token); assertSnapshotOwner(snapshot, userId); return execute(resumed); } public boolean cancelApproval(String token, String userId) { Map snapshot = taskRegistry.findByApprovalToken(token); agentApprovalService.cancel(token); assertSnapshotOwner(snapshot, userId); snapshot.put("status", "cancelled"); return true; } }
